subject: Enable int128_t path in libdivide_128_div_128_to_64
perf_evidence: Commit enables the native 128-bit arithmetic path for 128-by-128 narrowing division.
change_summary: Switches the 128-by-128 helper to native int128 arithmetic when available.

units.name: raw 128-by-128 quotient and remainder
units.evidence: Alive2 gives raw quotient/high-remainder counterexamples in both directions.

units.name: 128-by-128 helper with nonzero divisor and 64-bit quotient fit
units.evidence: For uh=1, ul=0, vh=13, vl=0, the old helper returns quotient 0x13b13b13b13b13b1 and new returns 0; the latter is the mathematical quotient. High remainder also differs.

units.name: public signed/unsigned 64-bit generator then recover
units.evidence: Signed-64 recovery passes both directions; unsigned-64 recovery times out in both directions. No public-API mismatch is established.

notes: The helper-level difference occurs even under the stated quotient-fit precondition, but the public recovery caller remains inconclusive. The old helper appears wrong on this direct input; that does not show a reachable public API regression or refinement.
